$comment: Tracked base commits for upstream-sync-check.yml. Update pinned_commit only via a merged auto-rebase PR (the PR includes the bump) or by hand after a manual rebase -- never edit this ahead of an actual verified rebase.

superproject.note: mici-sla-ui is sunnypilot's internal CI staging branch for the mici hardware target, not a stable/published release line, and carries no tags of its own. sunnypilot/sunnypilot's dated release tags (v2026.xxx.xxx) all have target_commitish=master, which mici-sla-ui diverges from -- they are not a valid freshness signal for this lineage. Freshness is tracked by diffing pinned_commit against tracked_ref's live HEAD instead. NOTE: torque-interceptor-port (the artifact branch with prebuilt binaries, built on the separate squashed release-mici lineage) has NO common git ancestor with mici-sla-ui -- confirmed via GitHub compare API. Rebasing must target torque-interceptor-base-mici, not torque-interceptor-port; landing a rebase here does not update torque-interceptor-port, which still requires the manual on-device build + binary-swap step.

opendbc.note: sunnypilot/opendbc publishes no releases and no tags at all (confirmed via API: both endpoints return empty arrays). Freshness is tracked purely by diffing pinned_commit against tracked_ref's (master) live HEAD. As of the last manual check, master was 99 commits ahead of pinned_commit.
